method_candidates.name: Review analysis, literature and synthesis claims separately
method_candidates.inputs: A frozen report, dataset and public source access; independent reviewers do not see generator code initially.
method_candidates.transformation: Classify claims by evidence type, independently recompute or retrieve support, then compare against the cited artifact.
method_candidates.outputs: Per-class support rates, discrepant claims and reproducible verification artifacts.
method_candidates.constraints: Small samples do not establish general reliability; ambiguous scientific interpretation needs domain expertise.
method_candidates.validation_proposal: On one already public report, sample 12 claims across three types; two blinded reviewers record support and agreement before opening generator artifacts. No experiment authorized here.

method_candidates.name: Persist a compact task and evidence handoff
method_candidates.inputs: Question, frozen objective, boundaries, source locators and unresolved issues.
method_candidates.transformation: Assign explicit output formats; condense findings while retaining citation anchors and uncertainty; inspect final claims against sources.
method_candidates.constraints: Summaries can drop qualifications; separate agents are not automatically statistically independent.
method_candidates.validation_proposal: For one public literature question, compare direct-source review with review from the handoff; measure missing caveats and wrong attributions at equal reviewer time.

method_candidates.name: Audit evidence origin before accepting benchmark success
method_candidates.inputs: Evaluation transcript, retrieved URLs and benchmark identity.
method_candidates.transformation: Mark benchmark-answer materials and cached query traces; distinguish original evidence from leaked keys; score contaminated outcomes separately.
method_candidates.outputs: Clean-result subset, contamination log and qualified score.
method_candidates.constraints: Open-web leakage changes over time; URL blocklists alone were insufficient in the cited report.
method_candidates.validation_proposal: Audit ten archived public trajectories before any rerun; two reviewers identify answer origins independently. Use a held-out question only if later separately authorized.

method_candidates.name: Review generated rationale as a scientific claim
method_candidates.inputs: Accepted text and a narrowly specified proposed edit.
method_candidates.transformation: Track added reasons, interpretation and first-person assertions; require author acceptance and evidence for substantive changes.
method_candidates.outputs: Small diff with rationale additions explicitly marked.
method_candidates.constraints: Practitioner precedent only; document-wide context does not guarantee faithful meaning.
method_candidates.validation_proposal: Use a public paragraph and two editing instructions; blinded subject review counts changed scientific commitments, missed caveats and review time. Do not alter the manuscript during this research.

gaps: The October 2026 biological project is a current and relevant initiative, but its linked bioRxiv paper returned 403: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.10.15.759436v1. The public report supports only the qualified project claims recorded above.
No included source supplies a representative frontier-model-versus-human comparison for physical-science research. Estimated months saved and blinded report preferences are different outcomes.
The current Prism announcement contains later page furniture and an undated shutdown banner. Publication date alone does not date every current page element.
Edison’s May 2026 post links a Nature lab-in-the-loop campaign; that scientific campaign was not inspected here and is not evidence for this packet.

Context engineering has a directly inspected September 29, 2025 Anthropic report, but it was omitted from the eight-source packet to prioritize the October 2026 project; no extra empirical context-window claims are imported.
No primary talk added: substantive original written reports gave checkable locators. Practitioner writing policy remains a norm example, not empirical failure evidence.

contradictions.resolution: Kosmos can attach source/code provenance while synthesis claims remain less reliable; provenance and independent verification address different questions.

Product labels and generated reports coexist with expert agenda-setting, claim review and follow-up experiments. Describe the demonstrated workflow rather than adjudicating a universal autonomy label.
Breadth can improve report preference or retrieval coverage while also increasing leakage exposure. Separate search capacity, compute budget and evidence independence.

contradictions.issue: Removing harnesses versus engineering a platform
contradictions.resolution: Edison’s language concerns replacing bespoke tool interfaces with code; its own architecture still uses sandboxes, proxies and persistent storage.

positioning: Use one or two modest main-text references for expert judgment and claim-level verification; place evolving products, autonomous systems and numerical qualifications in the fuller related-work appendix. Do not claim priority for these practices.
